title: S4: receiver knobs — prompt timeout + idle watchdog for long workflows
description: Story of #42 — see the plan doc for scope and done-when.

comments.author: nam20485
comments.text:
**Owner decision recorded (2026-10-17)**: "We don't kill it if it's still doing work — the watchdog kills only after X time WITH NO ACTIVITY. It should never kill a live process."

The timeout/watchdog core of this story landed as #50: idle watchdog (`ACP_IDLE_TIMEOUT`, default 300 s, protocol events as the heartbeat — the old orchestrator-service watchdog's idle model ported off the server-log mtime), with `ACP_PROMPT_TIMEOUT` repurposed as an opt-in hard ceiling (default 0 = disabled). Trigger evidence: the 2026-10-17 kilo24 dispatch was streaming ~200 events/min when the old flat 600 s cap killed it mid-init.

Remaining in this story after #50: the S3 noise-filter fold-in. (Interim until #50 merges: `ACP_PROMPT_TIMEOUT=3600` set in the host `.env`, receiver restarted.)
